INDEPENDENCE_LAW.sweep_validity_1a: a sweep over a single driver is VALID as an independence instrument only if its pairwise |rho| matrix contains at least one pair reading at or below the R5 ceiling of 0.80. A sweep in which every measured pair tracks above the ceiling is recorded as SWEEP_DEGENERATE_UNDER_DRIVER and yields no independence evidence in either direction — it may not disturb a verdict and may not support one. Rationale, declared before any matrix was read: rank correlation along a monotone driver is 1.0 by construction for any two monotonically-responding axes; divergence somewhere in the matrix is the only demonstration that the instrument resolves difference rather than restating the driver's own ordering — the sweep-space analogue of the documented N=4 census degeneracy. This condition is SYMMETRIC: it can void the number that threatens three verdicts and it can equally void a number that would have rescued one.
INDEPENDENCE_LAW.conjunctive_law_1b: two axes may both count toward one pair's two-axis requirement only if BOTH hold: (i) CENSUS CONDITION — unchanged, unmoved, not reinterpreted: |rho| across the family census at or below 0.80, subject to the recorded census-size caveat; (ii) DRIVER CONDITION — for every parameter that (a) is declared in the contract or is a builder constant proven to reach the render, (b) is proven REALIZED rather than NEVER_ARRIVES, and (c) actually differs in value between the two families of this specific pair, a sweep of that parameter on the rig carrying the counted axes must not show the two counted axes tracking above 0.80 — provided that sweep is VALID under 1a. A parameter that does not differ between the pair's families is not a driver for that pair. A differing but non-sweepable parameter is NON_SWEEPABLE_DRIVER: the pair is PASS_WITH_UNTESTED_DRIVER on the standing obligations list — not a FAIL (no tracking evidence exists), not clean (the check could not run).
INDEPENDENCE_LAW.asymmetry_1c: any verdict that IMPROVES under this amendment (a FAIL becoming PASS, a fenced provisional becoming clean) is NOT committed — recorded as AMENDMENT_INDUCED_IMPROVEMENT and held for the owner. Verdicts that DEGRADE are committed immediately. An amendment that can only help is a rescue vehicle; this asymmetry is what prevents it from becoming one.
INDEPENDENCE_LAW.strictly_additive: the amendment removes no condition and moves no bar; no pair that fails today can pass because of it
